name: Rooted-Wedge Obstruction
definition: Let $\mathcal L_4=\{0000,0100,0101,0111,1000,1010,1011,1100,1101,1110,1111\}$, rooted at $0^4$. On disjoint coordinate blocks define $\mathcal W_8=(\mathcal L_4\times\{0^4\})\cup(\{0^4\}\times\mathcal L_4)$. Equivalently, its low-bit vertex-incidence mask is `0x100010001000100010001000000010001000000010001000000000000fdb1`.
properties: $\mathcal L_4$ is a maximum VC-dimension-two cover-recursively peripheral class, but every peripheral semicube contains its root; all its root-preserving elementary minors admit root-avoiding decompositions. The wedge $\mathcal W_8$ has 21 vertices, is ample of VC dimension two, has crossing graph $K_4\mathbin{\dot\cup}K_4$, and is pc-minimal outside the cover-recursively peripheral class. It is a gated one-vertex amalgam of its two proper factors, has sixteen proper gated two-covers, and has seven cubical face decompositions: one over a vertex, four over an edge, and two over a square.
